mechanism.claim: Peer-reviewed connectedness evidence identifies the Korean stock market as a significant volatility emitter to Bitcoin in an asymmetric East-Asian spillover system. Follow the current KOSPI return direction when a large completed-session return reverses the prior session's sign during elevated completed BTC variation.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the current KOSPI close-to-close return after a strict sign transition

external_support.paper: Zeng (2023), Volatility spillover effect between Bitcoin and the East Asian stock market, International Journal of Managerial Finance
external_support.reported_fact: The study reports two-way asymmetric spillovers and identifies the Korean market as a significant volatility emitter in the Bitcoin/East-Asian stock system.
external_support.inference_disclosure: The Yahoo KOSPI proxy, strict-prior absolute-return rank, sign-transition event, BTC variation gate, five-minute publication buffer and 24-hour BTC hold are preregistered adaptations.

mechanism.why_distinct: HVKATR uses the Korean cash equity index at its native 15:30 Asia/Seoul close. Existing Korean candidates use Upbit/Binance crypto microstructure, premium, volume or venue leadership; the old cross-asset portability battery trades KODEX 200 and explicitly does not use KOSPI as a BTC signal.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: Both a top-40% KOSPI absolute-return shock and upper-35% completed BTC variation are required.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: Sparse KOSPI polarity transitions are released at the native 06:30 UTC cash close, a primitive and clock absent from Gross9.

features.sessions: Yahoo ^KS11 completed exchange sessions, dated in Asia/Seoul
features.kospi_return: log(close_t / close_(t-1 observed exchange session)), strict nonzero
features.kospi_shock_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(KOSPI return) over at most 252 valid sessions, minimum 126, current excluded; rank>=0.60
features.transition: current and previous valid-session KOSPI returns are strict nonzero and opposite in sign
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTCUSDT 1m log(close/open)) over the exact 24 hours ending at 15:30 Asia/Seoul
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid KOSPI decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.availability: the completed KOSPI daily bar is treated as available five elapsed minutes after the native close
features.missing: duplicate, weekend, nonpositive, nonfinite or implausibly gapped KOSPI sessions and missing BTC minutes reject; no imputation

clock.decision: KOSPI native 15:30 Asia/Seoul cash close plus 5 elapsed minutes
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT five-minute open 5 minutes after decision (normally 06:40 UTC)
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

equity.provider: Yahoo chart API current KOSPI history

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published Korean-market volatility-emitter result, asymmetric transition mechanism, volatile-state relevance, native-close novelty and exact repository absence

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, train/test/eval/final strict economics, then RV20 q90; no source, market, threshold, transition, side, hold, clock, subset or control repair
